question: The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association was founded in ______ by famous revolutionaries like Chandrasekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, Batukeshwar Dutt and others.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1928**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Hindustan Socialist Republican Association** (HSRA) was an organization of revolutionaries in India.
 
• It was founded in **1928** by famous revolutionaries like **Chandrasekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, Batukeshwar Dutt** and others.
 
• The HSRA aimed at overthrowing the British rule in India through **armed struggle**.
 
• It was initially known as the **Hindustan Republican Association** (HRA) before it was reorganized as HSRA.
 
• The association was influenced by socialist principles and aimed to establish a **federal republic** of the United States of India.
 
• The notable actions carried out by HSRA include the **Kakori train robbery** in 1925 and the **bombing of the Central Legislative Assembly** in 1929.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA)**__

 
 
• The HSRA had its roots in the **Hindustan Republican Association** (HRA), which was established in 1924.
 
• The name was changed to HSRA in 1928 to reflect the association's commitment to **socialist principles**.
 
• The HSRA's manifesto, titled "**Philosophy of the Bomb**," was written by **Bhagat Singh** and **B.K. Dutt**.
 
• The manifesto emphasized the need for a revolution to achieve **complete independence** and the establishment of a **socialist state**.
